core_obligations: For the uniqueness part, show that uniqueness for g bounds the north-west dotted arrow and then uniqueness for f bounds the north-north-west dotted arrow (proof lines 8746-8750).
For the existence part, apply the criterion for g to obtain K', A' and Spec(A') -> Y (proof lines 8765-8766).
Apply the criterion for f on top of the result to obtain K'' over K', A'' and Spec(A'') -> X, completing the diagram (proof lines 8766-8768).
Present the two-stage construction as the single commutative diagram displayed in the proof (proof lines 8750-8764).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a composition of two morphisms of algebraic spaces satisfying the existence part (resp. uniqueness part) of the valuative criterion again satisfies it (source lines 8728-8734). The uniqueness part is read off the uniqueness for the two factors applied to the two dotted arrows of the displayed diagram. The existence part is an explicit two-stage construction: the criterion for g : Y -> Z produces the extension K' of K, a valuation ring A' and an arrow Spec(A') -> Y, and then the criterion for f : X -> Y produces a further extension K'' of K', a valuation ring A'' and an arrow Spec(A'') -> X, whose composite with f is the required arrow.
